title: Just Magnet, nothing more
description: This mod adds just magnets to the game. They can picked up items. Nothing more
body:
# Just Magnet, nothing more

A minimalist mod for Minecraft that adds **just magnets**. Nothing more.

## Philosophy

This mod does one thing and does it well: **magnets for item pickup**. No extra features, no bloat, no unnecessary complexity. Just magnets. That's our key feature - simplicity.

## What this mod adds

- **Magnet Core** - basic component for crafting magnets
- **Advanced Magnet Core** - improved version of the core
- **Magnet** - standard magnet for automatic item pickup
- **Advanced Magnet** - improved version with higher durability and pickup range

That's it. Nothing more.

## Features

- **Automatic item pickup** - magnets collect nearby items
- **Toggle on/off** - right-click to activate/deactivate your magnet
- **Server-side configuration** - adjust pickup radius and durability
- **Enchantment support** - works with Unbreaking and Mending
- **Recyclable** - smelt broken magnets back into cores to craft them again
- **Two tiers** - basic and advanced magnets for different needs

## Crafting

### Magnet Core
Crafted from **9 Iron Blocks** + **1 Netherite Ingot**

![Magnet Core Recipe](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/skvoryanich/just-magnet-nothing-more-mod/refs/heads/main/public/core.png)

### Advanced Magnet Core
Crafted from **9 Diamond Blocks** + **1 Magnet Core**

![Advanced Magnet Core Recipe](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/skvoryanich/just-magnet-nothing-more-mod/refs/heads/main/public/adv_core.png)

### Magnets
Use the cores to craft basic and advanced magnets.

![basic](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/skvoryanich/just-magnet-nothing-more-mod/refs/heads/main/public/craft.png)

![advanced](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/skvoryanich/just-magnet-nothing-more-mod/refs/heads/main/public/advcraft.png)

## Recycling

Broken or unwanted magnets can be smelted back into their cores, allowing you to craft new magnets. Nothing goes to waste!


## Configuration

Server-side configuration allows you to adjust:
- **Pickup radius** - how far the magnet can reach
- **Durability** - how long magnets last before breaking

## Requirements

- [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)
- [Cloth Config](https://modrinth.com/mod/cloth-config)

## That's all

Seriously, that's everything this mod does. Just magnets. Nothing more.
